pages: Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, stands at the withy bed on the frozen river bank holding one freshly cut willow rod. Middle distance: a billhook in the grass, a straw-bound bundle of rods, an axe head. Background: pollarded willow stools and the river, low winter sun.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, drives one extra long willow stake into the ground at the left-hand side of a ring of stakes. Middle distance: a coil of tarred twine, a stub of chalk. Background: the withy bed and slow river water, frost on the grass.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, pushes a marked stick down beside each stake as she counts round the ring. Middle distance: one stake standing taller than the rest, a chalk stub, a heap of withies. Background: the withy bed, morning light on the water.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, holds one pale willow rod across the top of the basket wall, at a gap where rod crosses rod and nothing passes under. Middle distance: a counting stick, the remaining withies, a bundle of willow. Background: the riverside bed, flat grey light.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, kneels beside one unfinished basket whose wall runs crooked and whose rim stands open. Middle distance: loose withies, the counting stick, a coil of twine. Background: the low wall by the river, overcast afternoon.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, sits on the low river wall with the basket in her lap, lifting the first rod from the row above the base. Middle distance: a heap of rods, her counting stick. Background: the withy bed and water, Friday evening.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, lays one long withy on the heap in front of the others, longest first. Middle distance: the bare stakes standing in the ground, the last rods still woven. Background: the riverside wall, soft evening.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, stretches one tarred twine line between two pegs and marks it with chalk. Middle distance: the lifted ring of stakes set closer together, a chalk stub. Background: the withy bed and the river, bright morning.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, lowers one flat stone onto the withies lying in the horse trough. Middle distance: brown cracked rods, a heap of straw, a wooden pail. Background: the yard and the byres, evening shadow.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, kneels and draws the rim of the finished basket inward with both hands until the edges meet. Middle distance: one boxwood rule laid across the top, a stub of chalk. Background: the river at dusk, willows dark on the far bank.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, writes in one ruled ledger book lying open on the withy bench with a stub of chalk. Middle distance: rods sorted by length, small onion baskets, a slatted fish crate. Background: the river and the withy bed, morning.

Wenna, a girl of thirteen, long black hair in a braid, a red shawl over a grey frock, lays one hand flat on the closed ledger book on the bench. Middle distance: the sorted heap of withies, the narrowed basket beside her knee. Background: the river, quiet evening light, willows still.
